metadata.coverage_note: Evergreen markers are one point per geocoded facility. The default view emphasizes facilities with a latest observed closure, reinspection, compliance-order or scheduled follow-up/reinspection result in the most recent 60-day window. Facilities without reviewed coordinates are counted but not mapped; blank or missing red-point totals are not treated as zero.
metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports and facility inspection-history pages; this public evergreen layer is one mapped point per facility.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.
metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not show neighborhood-level health risk, facilities without reviewed coordinates, or source records not yet collected by the scraper.
metadata.map_claim: Shows geocoded public restaurant facilities with current/latest TPCHD action status, latest inspection result, red-point context, and observed follow-up timeline where available.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

metadata.source_note: Tacoma-Pierce County Health Department Accela food-facility inspection pages and parsed inspection-report PDFs.

symbology.note: Evergreen markers use latest TPCHD action status as the primary shape/letter encoding. Action-status markers darken with the worst parsed red-point total shown for that facility. Alert/run maps are static per-alert layers and use fixed red-point classes.
